about: The roadmap of the port. Owned by the plan thread. Steps are small enough for one PR with its explainer. To pick the next step: take the first step with status todo whose phase is open and whose components' dependencies (see coverage.json) are ported. A PR that finishes a step sets its status, post and pr here.

milestones.title: Format parity
milestones.proof: gleam-in-nim format prints byte for byte what gleam format prints, on the 918 upstream formatter tests, on gleam_stdlib and on the corpus.

milestones.title: Check parity
milestones.proof: Same errors and warnings as the reference on the upstream type checker tests; same package interface JSON as gleam export package-interface on gleam_stdlib and the corpus.

milestones.title: The standard library compiles to Erlang
milestones.proof: compile-package --target erlang --no-beam gives byte identical .erl and .hrl files for gleam_stdlib and the corpus; the 483 upstream Erlang snapshots reproduce.

milestones.title: It runs on the BEAM
milestones.proof: In CI, with Erlang/OTP installed, the output of the port passes upstream's test/language suite and gleam_stdlib's own tests.

milestones.title: JavaScript parity
milestones.proof: Byte identical .mjs and .d.mts for gleam_stdlib and the corpus; the 843 upstream JavaScript snapshots reproduce; test/language passes on Node.

milestones.title: A real build tool
milestones.proof: gleam-in-nim new, add, build, test and run work on a fresh project with Hex dependencies, with no reference binary involved.

milestones.title: Port complete
milestones.proof: Every row of the coverage map is verified or listed as an intentional divergence; the language server answers an editor.

phases.title: Groundwork
phases.goal: Know the terrain, set up the workshop.

steps.title: Explainer workflow and repository scaffold
steps.what: nimib site, theme, review mode, devlog, roadmap and coverage pages, CI.
steps.done_when: The site builds in CI and is published.
steps.owner: Set up explainer workflow and repo

steps.title: Gleam, its community and a corpus of programs
steps.what: What Gleam is, who makes it, and a list of real Gleam packages to compile.
steps.done_when: A corpus manifest (name, git URL, commit) is in the repo.
steps.owner: Research Gleam, its community and corpus

steps.title: The BEAM and Elm roots
steps.what: What Gleam compiles to and where its design comes from.
steps.owner: Explain the BEAM and Elm roots

steps.title: How Gleam's compiler is made
steps.what: Architecture, sizes, history, comparison with other compilers.

steps.title: The port plan
steps.what: Scope, order, backend choice, verification plan, this roadmap and the coverage map.
steps.done_when: Roadmap and coverage data are in main.

steps.title: Lessons from other rewrites, decision records and test tooling
steps.what: How large ports are run; snapshot corpus index, differential test harness, port map.
steps.done_when: tools/snapcorpus, tools/difftest and tools/portmap run in CI.

steps.title: Harvest the upstream Rust tests
steps.what: Many upstream tests keep inputs and expected values in Rust macros, not in snapshot files: 918 formatter assertions, 374 inference assertions, lexer and parser assertions, dependency modules of backend tests. Extract them to JSON test vectors.
steps.done_when: Every upstream assertion macro call is available as data, with counts per component in the coverage map.

steps.title: Erlang in CI
steps.what: Add Erlang/OTP, Node and the reference binary to CI so compiled output can be executed.
steps.done_when: CI can run erlc and escript; a smoke test compiles and runs reference output.

phases.title: Front end
phases.goal: Source text to syntax tree and back to text. Ends with milestone M1.

steps.title: Source spans and line numbers
steps.what: SrcSpan and LineNumbers, the coordinates every later phase uses.

steps.title: Lexer
steps.what: Text to tokens, with comments and lexical errors.
steps.done_when: Lexer assertions from parse/tests.rs pass; tokens of every corpus file match in kind and position.
steps.owner: Port the Gleam lexer to Nim

steps.title: Untyped syntax tree
steps.what: The data types of the untyped AST: modules, definitions, expressions, patterns, constants, type annotations.
steps.done_when: Types compile and can represent every construct the parser produces.

steps.title: Parser: expressions and statements
steps.what: Expression units, operator precedence, blocks, let, use, assert, case, patterns, bit arrays.
steps.done_when: parse_statement_sequence accepts every expression test input.

steps.title: Parser: modules
steps.what: Definitions, attributes, imports, custom types, type annotations, constants, doc comments and the extra comment table.
steps.done_when: Every file of gleam_stdlib and the corpus parses.

steps.title: Diagnostics and parse errors
steps.what: A faithful port of the codespan-style renderer, then every parse error message.
steps.done_when: The parse error snapshots reproduce byte for byte.

steps.title: Pretty printer
steps.what: The document algebra: groups, breaks, nesting, and the fitting algorithm.

steps.title: Formatter
steps.what: gleam format: syntax tree and comments back to canonical text.

steps.title: Milestone M1: format parity on the corpus
steps.what: Differential run of format over gleam_stdlib and the corpus against the reference binary.
steps.done_when: Zero differences, or each difference filed and fixed.

phases.title: Analysis
phases.goal: Give every expression a type, find every mistake. Ends with milestone M2.

steps.title: Types, prelude and unification
steps.what: Type and TypeVar, the prelude types, environment, instantiate, unify, generalise, the type printer.
steps.done_when: Unification and printing unit tests pass.

steps.title: Typed syntax tree
steps.what: TypedExpr, typed patterns, constants and definitions.

steps.title: Inference: the expression core
steps.what: Literals, variables, functions, calls, let, blocks, operators, tuples, lists.

steps.title: Inference: custom types and records
steps.what: Type and value constructors, labelled arguments, field access, record update, variant inference.
steps.done_when: Custom type and accessor tests pass.

steps.title: Inference: patterns and case
steps.what: Pattern typing, case clauses, alternative patterns, string prefix and bit array patterns, guards.

steps.title: Inference: pipes, use, constants, todo, panic, echo
steps.what: The remaining expression forms and module constants.
steps.done_when: Pipe, use and constant tests pass.

steps.title: Module analysis
steps.what: Imports, definition registration, the call graph and dependency ordering, generalisation, multi module projects, target support.
steps.done_when: assert_module_infer tests and multi module tests pass.

steps.title: Exhaustiveness and decision trees
steps.what: Compile case expressions to decision trees; report missing and unreachable patterns.

steps.title: Type errors
steps.what: Every type error message, in upstream wording.

steps.title: Warnings and reference tracking
steps.what: Unused code, deprecations, dead code detection, version inference, and their messages.

steps.title: Package interface and milestone M2
steps.what: Export public types as JSON and compare with the reference on gleam_stdlib and the corpus.
steps.done_when: Zero differences in package interface JSON and in diagnostics.

phases.title: Erlang backend and a first build
phases.goal: Typed tree to Erlang, package by package. Ends with milestones M3 and M4.

steps.title: Erlang source builder
steps.what: The structured builder that writes Erlang text (the textual half of erlang-generation).

steps.title: Erlang backend: modules, functions, expressions
steps.what: Module header, exports, functions, calls, operators, strings, lists, tuples, blocks.

steps.title: Erlang backend: patterns, case, guards, bit arrays
steps.what: Everything that pattern matches.
steps.done_when: Case, guard, pattern and bit array snapshots reproduce.

steps.title: Erlang backend: records, type specs, docs, assert, echo
steps.what: Record headers (.hrl), -spec and -type, documentation attributes, runtime errors, echo.

steps.title: Files, configuration and metadata
steps.what: The IO abstraction with an in-memory file system, gleam.toml and manifest parsing, the module metadata cache.
steps.done_when: Config tests pass; metadata round trips.

steps.title: Package compiler and compile-package
steps.what: Load a package, order its modules, analyse, generate, write; the compile-package command.

steps.title: Milestone M3: the standard library compiles
steps.what: Differential run of compile-package --target erlang --no-beam over gleam_stdlib and the corpus.

steps.title: Milestone M4: run it on the BEAM
steps.what: In CI, compile test/language and gleam_stdlib with the port and run their tests on Erlang/OTP.

phases.title: JavaScript backend
phases.goal: The second target. Ends with milestone M5.

steps.title: JavaScript: modules, imports, functions, expressions
steps.what: The generator skeleton and the expression printer, on top of the pretty printer.

steps.title: JavaScript: custom types, equality, records, constants
steps.what: Classes for custom types, the prelude contract, constants.
steps.done_when: Custom type and constant snapshots reproduce.

steps.title: JavaScript: case and let assert from decision trees
steps.what: Turn the decision trees of step 2.8 into if/else chains and bindings.

steps.title: JavaScript: bit arrays, echo, runtime errors
steps.what: The remaining expression forms.

steps.title: TypeScript declarations
steps.what: The .d.mts printer.

steps.title: Source maps
steps.what: Cursor observation in the pretty printer and source map v3 output.

steps.title: Milestone M5: JavaScript parity
steps.what: Differential run over gleam_stdlib and the corpus; run test/language on Node.

phases.title: The rest of the toolchain
phases.goal: From a compiler to a build tool. Ends with milestone M6.

steps.title: Project compiler
steps.what: Many packages, incremental builds, caches, native files, Erlang and Elixir dependencies.

steps.title: build, check, run, test, clean, export
steps.what: The everyday commands.

steps.title: Erlang abstract format
steps.what: The binary builder and the Erlang term format encoder: .abstr files, what gleam build writes at the pin.

steps.title: Hex versions and dependency resolution
steps.what: Version and requirement parsing, the PubGrub solver, the manifest.

steps.title: Hex client and the dependency commands
steps.what: Download and unpack packages; deps, add, remove, update.
steps.done_when: A project with Hex dependencies builds from scratch.

steps.title: new, fix, shell, docs, publish
steps.what: Project templates, the HTML documentation generator, publishing and the rest.
steps.done_when: Docs snapshots reproduce; new project matches the reference template.

phases.title: Language server and wrap up
phases.goal: The editor experience, then the audit. Ends with milestone M7.

steps.title: Language server: engine, hover, go to definition, references
steps.what: The server loop, the compiler in the loop, and the read only features.
steps.done_when: The matching language server snapshots reproduce.

steps.title: Language server: completion, rename, signature help
steps.what: Features that need a fault tolerant tree.

steps.title: Language server: code actions
steps.what: The long tail of code actions.

steps.title: The compiler in the browser
steps.what: Upstream ships a WebAssembly build; ours can come from Nim's JavaScript backend.
steps.done_when: The compiler runs in a web page.

steps.title: Final audit
steps.what: Run every upstream test, list every divergence, compare speed and binary size with the reference, decide whether to follow a newer Gleam release.
